column1: # Story words added to the vocabulary list (tools/build_vocab_data.py, "From stories" units S1...).
# Every word here was met in a Kanji Trail story, had no curriculum entry, and was reviewed as worth
# studying: common in speech or writing (JMdict priority-tagged), not a name, not a grammar pattern, and
# not a spelling of an entry the list already teaches. Pinned to an exact JMdict entry (ent_seq) so a
# homograph cannot slip in: のぞく is 覗く "to peek", not 除く "to remove".

# story-writing-guide.md §5a). Columns, tab-separated: surface, reading, JMdict ent_seq, first story
